definitions.explanation: The outcome or result of an action.
The degree to which something produces the desired result.

examples.japanese: {薬|くすり}の{効果|こうか}が{出|で}てきた。
examples.english: The medicine is starting to take effect.

examples.japanese: この{運動|うんどう}を{続|つづ}ければ、ダイエットの{効果|こうか}が{出|で}るはずだ。
examples.english: If you keep up this exercise, you should see results from the diet.

examples.japanese: {効果|こうか}{的|てき}な{方法|ほうほう}
この{薬|くすり}はとても{効果|こうか}{的|てき}だ。
{効果|こうか}{的|てき}に{勉強|べんきょう}するには、まず{計画|けいかく}を{立|た}てることが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: To study effectively, the first important thing is to make a plan.

notes:
{効果|こうか} refers to effects and results.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {効果|こうか}がある (to have an effect)
- {効果|こうか}が{出|で}る (effect appears)
- {効果|こうか}{的|てき} (effective)
- {逆|ぎゃく}{効果|こうか} (counterproductive effect)

TYPES:
- {副作用|ふくさよう} (side effect)
- {相乗|そうじょう}{効果|こうか} (synergistic effect)
